headline: “Now About 8 Trading Days Left” Foreseen Fear… Beyond ‘Samjeon-Nix’ to Concerns Over the Kospi [Investment 360]
summary: Share buybacks by Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, seen as solid support for the domestic stock market, are nearing their end. Investors worry that both large programs ending at the same time could weigh on the market.
why: The Kospi is South Korea's main stock index, heavily weighted toward Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix, the country's two largest chipmakers. Buybacks support share prices, so their end can change demand for these stocks.

impacts.name: Kospi
impacts.why: Concern over the end of large buybacks by the two biggest index heavyweights may weigh on the index.
